## Resolution summary

All 17 `WHEN DISCHARGING` rows map to **NM0028762 (Aztec)**. The permit package provides establishing text.

**Disposition: SUPPORTED_RESOLUTION**

The DMR comment encodes permit footnote **\*1 When discharging**, which qualifies **monitoring frequencies** (the `(*1)` markers in the MEASUREMENT FREQUENCY column), not effluent limit values. Monitoring at the stated frequency is required only when the outfall is discharging. When there is no discharge in a sampling month, the permittee uses **NO DISCHARGE** reporting instead. Numeric effluent limits remain in force for discharges when they occur. Whether discharge actually occurred in a given period is a **separate factual question** not encoded in structured CSV fields.
